reason: Hypothesis B proposes a physically sound, well-established oxygen diffusion barrier mechanism (ALD Al₂O₃) that directly addresses the oxidation limitation without altering the bulk alloy, and it specifies a clear, testable intervention with measurable outcomes and a decisive falsification experiment. Hypothesis A relies on a mechanism (fluorine-catalyzed protective oxide formation) extrapolated from TiAl alloys without direct evidence in HfNbTaTiZr, and it introduces unnecessary complexity (ion implantation damage, annealing) with less certainty of preserving mechanical properties.
